item.title: Week 10: Rams at Cardinals
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:05 PM ET | Line: LA -9.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model ARI 18% vs. market 19% | On paper the Rams have the edge, led by their pocket protection: they rank 2nd in pressure rate (20%), while Arizona's defense ranks 32nd (20% generated). Arizona's best counter is its run defense, which ranks 3rd, though its pass defense ranks 29th. Stafford ranks 15th of 31 in EPA per dropback, and the data has no Arizona quarterback rank to compare him with, while Puka Nacua (31% of targets, 32% of air yards, 2nd of 108 in WOPR at 0.81) faces that 29th-ranked pass defense. The model favors the Rams at 82% win probability, driven by rushing matchup (+5.2 points) and passing matchup (+4.6 points), close to the market's 81%.
